title: Trauma Responses in Children
learning_goal: Recognise trauma responses such as fight, flight, freeze, and fawn in children.

content.micro_lesson: Trauma alters the nervous system. Children may appear aggressive, avoidant, shut down, overly compliant, or hyperactive. These behaviours are survival responses, not misbehaviour.
content.activity: Match behaviours to trauma responses using a worksheet.
content.caseworker_flags: Freeze or fawn responses toward a perpetrator.
content.escalation_trigger: Child dissociation or shutdown triggers urgent clinical referral.
